S-WIDGETS.Purpose: Declarative UI: reconciled widget instances, Flexbox layout, visual geometry, native IMGUI rendering and event routing, plus concrete containers and controls.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Base Widget with flat reactive Props, instance lifecycle, layout properties, visual self transforms and native child-context hooks.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Instance-tree reconciliation, signal queue, geometry snapshots, clipping, paint order, focus and pointer/keyboard event dispatch.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: Containers View, ScrollView and CanvasView; display widgets Label and Image; Button and controlled Checkbox, TextField and sliders.
Scope.SCP-IN-005: Native appearance primitives and gradient textures consumed as ordinary background images.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Behavior tick scheduling — owned by S-RUNTIME-PLATFORM.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Widget source generation and weaving — owned by S-METAPROGRAMMING.
Scope.SCP-OUT-003: Browser DOM, CSS parser, stencil renderer, offscreen subtree compositor and group postprocessing.

Principles.PRIN-001: Widgets are declarative definitions; the engine owns mutable instances and keyed reconciliation.
Principles.PRIN-002: Preserve native RimWorld/Unity IMGUI behavior where it is necessary for controls, focus, caret, selection and IME.
Principles.PRIN-003: Concrete widgets own their surface drawing and specialized native child contexts; the base Widget declares hooks and the renderer supplies common IMGUI execution.
Principles.PRIN-004: Component API design prioritizes internal FlexVerse consistency, then React semantics, then conventions across UI frameworks; render constraints may affect the public API.
Principles.PRIN-005: Layout is authoritative for box size and position; visual transforms affect rendering and hit testing without modifying Flexbox layout.
Principles.PRIN-006: Reconciliation owns instance identity and properties; Flexbox owns layout calculation; IMGUI owns native drawing and input. These areas exchange data and measurement/context hooks through explicit contracts without requiring independence from each other.

Requirements.REQ-001: ProcessUI dispatches input using the previous geometry snapshot, reconciles the current definition, processes signals/layout once, refreshes geometry/clips, then renders.
Requirements.REQ-002: Pointer input targets the highest painted eligible widget and bubbles target-first; StopPropagation prevents further bubbling.
Requirements.REQ-003: Inherited context resolves to the nearest ancestor provider and shadows outer providers.
Requirements.REQ-004: Props are externally supplied inputs, including Behavior objects. Controlled inputs report proposed changes through OnValueChange and do not assign the authoritative Value or Checked themselves.
Requirements.REQ-005: State belongs to the widget instance, survives reconciliation by identity and is not duplicated when derivable from input.
Requirements.REQ-006: Overflow clips descendants in the native rectangular padding box; decoration and BorderRadius of a widget's own surface do not imply rounded clipping of children.
Requirements.REQ-007: ZIndex orders sibling subtrees stably for paint and hit testing without changing declaration order or Flexbox layout.
